sloka: तत् प्रयातम् बलम् घोरम् अशिवम् शोणित उदकम् ।अभ्यवर्षत् महा मेघः तुमुलो गर्दभ अरुणः ॥३-२३-१॥
transliteration: tat prayātam balam ghoram aśivam śoṇita udakam ।abhyavarṣat mahā meghaḥ tumulo gardabha aruṇaḥ ॥3-23-1॥

translations.english: As the army marched from there (Janasthana) a huge dark cloud of the colour of an ass rained dreadful inauspicious water, red as blood.
